scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, closure, fire, disaster, or outage
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions from storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was verified in the bounded interval.
notable_exclusions: Kauaʻi Hurricane Lowell recovery coverage was published October 2 and predates the interval.
SNAP policy/caseload stories and generic program-change coverage lacked a new immediate service interruption in the interval.
Routine community, food-promotion, resource, and unrelated fire-safety results were excluded.
